technical_and_design_decisions: U1 (Reactor Stream Processor): Implement a module wrapper and option metadata reader for Reactor-based stream processors to allow minimal configuration (specifying just processor class).
U2 (Reactor 2.0 RC1 Upgrade): Upgrade Reactor dependencies in build configurations and refactor any breaking API changes across the framework.
U3/U4 (Redis Aggregate Field-Value Counters): Port time-series bucketed aggregation over Redis from the legacy implementation, covering minute/hour/day/month counter rollups.
U5 (Hadoop Test Isolation): Extract Hadoop-dependent tests into a dedicated subproject (`spring-xd-hadoop-tests`) to clean up DIRT dependencies and resolve Eclipse `.classpath` generation issues.
U6 (YARN EC2 Acceptance Tests): Develop automated acceptance test scripts using AWS/EC2 test harness to verify XD core features deployed on YARN.
U7 (RxJava Processor Module): Build an RxJava processor module adapter that exposes RxJava `Observable` stream transformations for incoming messages.
U8 (HTTP Source Message Size Config): Expose `maxContentLength` in the HTTP source module configuration properties and map it to Netty's `HttpChunkAggregator`, configurable via `servers.yml`.
assumptions: Requirements U3 and U4 are identical duplicates in the specification and are treated as a single combined feature implementation.
Target environment has existing EC2 credentials and automated test scripts or infrastructure capable of provisioning temporary test clusters for YARN acceptance testing.
All code changes require corresponding unit and integration tests as well as updated reference documentation.
Developer has existing domain knowledge of Spring XD, Netty, Redis, and Reactor/RxJava frameworks.

activities.activity_description: Implement reactor-based stream processor support allowing minimal module options (processor class specification), option parsing, and integration testing.
Upgrade project build files to Reactor 2.0 RC1, resolve API incompatibilities, and verify full build test suite pass.

activities.activity_name: Redis Aggregate Field-Value Counters Porting & Implementation
activities.activity_description: Port aggregate field-value counter specifications from legacy codebase, implement Redis time-bucket aggregation repository/processor, address identified gaps, and update reference documentation.
Create a separate module for Hadoop tests, move tests out of DIRT project, fix Eclipse classpath generator configs, and verify build isolation.

activities.activity_name: XD + YARN on EC2 Acceptance Test Suite
activities.activity_description: Develop and verify automated acceptance test suite for Spring XD on YARN running on EC2 instances for continuous build verification.
Create RxJava-based processor module, implement messaging adapters for RxJava Observables, write tests and module documentation.

activities.activity_name: HTTP Source Configurable Message Size Limit
activities.activity_description: Expose HttpChunkAggregator max content length setting in HTTP source module, enable override via servers.yml, and add unit/integration tests.
